messages:
jin: Heads-up: release/promote-2026 is blocked. Staging smoke suite keeps failing on exporter_svc_test with OOM in the test container. Not panicking yet but this is stopping the promote.

sara: saw it. deploy-bot aborted the promote automatically? :thinking:

deploy-bot: Automatic action: promote aborted due to pipeline failure in job `release/promote-2026`. Reason: job failure (exporter_svc_test). See CI run 1987.

ryan: logging from the failing test:
```
E 03:47:12 module=test_exporter.go:94: runtime: out of memory: cannot allocate 8388608 bytes
panic: out of memory
```

alex: that's new — we didn't change exporter in this release. Any chance it's test parallelism bump? The test spins up multiple exporters.

jin: the PR did bump `-parallel=8` -> `-parallel=16` in test job. I didn't think that would change memory footprint that much.

sara: repro locally with `ci-runner-bot` image? Might be an infra resource cap. @ci-runner-bot can you run the same job with reduced parallelism?

ci-runner-bot: Queued job `repro/exporter-oom` on the same node pool with env `CI_PARALLEL=8`. ETA ~6m.

ryan: suggestion: pin exporter image to v1.3.4 (the known-good) for the promote while we investigate. We can do a hotfix rollback if needed.

jin: agree. We should also add a temporary gate in the release notes to not auto-promote until this is cleared. I'll open a PR to pin the image and add a note.

alex: operationally: hold the promote, patch the chart in the staging manifest to use `exporter:v1.3.4`, kick off a canary smoke run. If passes, re-run promote manually.

sara: +1. Also check node pool memory requests — looks like the test uses host-level memory limits that might interact with kernel oom behavior.

jin: Update: ci-runner-bot finished the repro run and it succeeded with `CI_PARALLEL=8` and failed with `CI_PARALLEL=16`. So repro confirmed.

ryan: ok pin + hold. Jin, can you file the rollback/pin PR and add the release hold tag? I'll notify the release manager.

jin: filed PR 4523: `pin/exporter-1.3.4-staging` and added `release-blocker` label. Also added note in the release doc: "Hold: exporter OOM under high parallelism — pinned to 1.3.4 until root cause." Link: https://go/release/4523

sara: thanks. I'll keep an eye on the root cause. If root cause looks like infra, we'll open infra ticket to increase test node RAM or add quotas.

alex: decision: no rollback to prod yet — this is staging-only smoke failure. We will not promote until a successful staging smoke with the pin. If pin passes, manual promote after 1h observation window.

ryan: ping @release-manager when manual promote is OK.

deploy-bot: Manual promote is blocked until thread resolves. Use `/deploy promote --manual` to attempt once cleared.

jin: closing loop: will monitor CI, do a postmortem note if exporter change triggered this. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
